beats.en: Light travels in straight lines, and when it falls on a smooth surface it bounces back, which is called reflection.
beats.speakEn: Light travels in straight lines, and when it falls on a smooth surface it bounces back, which is called reflection.

beats.en: The laws of reflection: the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection, and both rays and the normal lie in one plane.

textbookBox.concept: A plane mirror forms an upright image of the same size, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and it is laterally inverted.

beats.en: A plane mirror forms an upright image of the same size, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and it is laterally inverted.
beats.speakEn: A plane mirror forms an upright image of the same size, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front, and it is laterally inverted.

beats.en: A concave mirror curves inward like the inside of a spoon and can make magnified images when the object is close.
beats.speakEn: A concave mirror curves inward like the inside of a spoon and can make magnified images when the object is close.
